senses.gloss: f. (נסק; cmp. מַסְקָנָא) ascending, landing. גמלא דא׳ landing board.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 67b:18">Snh. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>וקם אג׳ דא׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>וקם ג׳ דוסקנ׳</he> read with Rashi <he>דסקונ׳</he>, Ms. M. <he>איסקניתא</he>, oth. var. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) and he found himself standing on a landing board (ed. and there stood before him &c.).
